[[File:Amidala_jewel.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Queen Padmé Amidala wearing the Jewel of Zenda]]
The '''Jewel of Zenda''' was a large red gemstone found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Jewel of Zenda was considered to be a royal jewel by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people of Naboo]].

During her reign as sovereign of the [[Royal House of Naboo]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] wore the Jewel of Zenda in the headpiece of her royal gown. The jewel could also be set into a pendant and worn around the neck.

Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] wore a royal gown similar in design to Amidala's dress following the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She apparently wore the Jewel of Zenda in her headdress when the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] her and her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] bodyguards in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].
